en: Timesheet, invoices, profit and cash for your social media agency
Timesheet, invoices, profit and cash for your agency
each block of work gets a rate, a cost and a value if billed, so every brand shows what its hours really cost you
billable hours against the hours each person has, with a result against the utilisation you aim for
revenue, hours, cost of time and direct expenses give the profit, the margin and the revenue for each hour of every brand
see which of your packages earn their price and which lose money once the real hours are counted
Invoices with tax and late fees
tax, total, payments, balance, days overdue and the late fee fill in for every invoice
open money split into not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days with a chase list
monthly fee, next invoice date, months running and yearly value for each retainer
every extra request gets a price, a cost and the amount you still have to recover
revenue, cost of time, expenses and overhead build the profit and margin of every month
twelve coming months of retainers, collections, costs and one-off spending with the lowest cash warning
tax on invoices, tax on costs and income tax on profit give the amount to move each month and the gap
your rates against the market with the extra a raise earns, and the break-even and payback of each possible hire

Team members, pay and billable time
One row for each team member and helper with cost and charge-out rate per hour; hours, billable share, value of time and workload for the last 90 days come from the timesheet.
Timesheet: every hour for every brand
One row for each block of work: who, which brand, what kind of work and how long; the rate, the cost of the time and the value if billable fill in by themselves.
Billing and admin tasks with owner and hours
One row for each task with owner, due date and hours; the hours left, days to go and a flag for late and due soon tasks fill in.
One row for each absence with who covers; the days, working days, hours lost and whether the person is away now fill in.
Invoices to clients with tax, balance and late fee
One row for each invoice with its net amount and due date; the tax, total, paid, balance, days overdue, late fee and status fill in from the payments.
Payments received and how late they were
One row for each payment against an invoice; the brand, the days from issue to payment and whether it came on time fill in.
One row for each client with the agreed terms; billed, paid, open balance and the balance by age (not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days) come from the invoices.
Recurring retainers and the next invoice
One row for each monthly retainer with fee, start and billing day; the months running, the amount billed so far, the next invoice date and the yearly value fill in.
Out-of-scope work and what it should earn
One row for each extra request outside the package; the price at your standard rate, your cost, the margin and the amount still to recover fill in.
Expenses: tools, freelancers and costs for clients
One row for each expense with its kind and the brand it belongs to; mark whether you charge it on to the client. The month and the brand fill in.
Tool subscriptions and what they cost for each client
One row for each tool with price, cycle, seats and use; the cost a month and a year, the cost for each seat and each active client and the renewal warning fill in.
Profit by client over the last 12 months
One row for each brand; revenue, hours, cost of time, direct expenses, profit, margin and the real rate for each hour come from invoices, timesheet and expenses.
One row for each package with its list price and planned hours; the clients on it, revenue, hours, profit, margin and the real revenue for each hour fill in.
Profit and loss for every month
One row for each month with your other income and overhead; revenue, cost of time, expenses, profit and margin fill in from invoices, the timesheet and expenses.
Cash flow forecast for the next 12 months
One row for each coming month with the new sales and one-off costs you expect; retainers, collections, team cost, tools, overhead and the cash balance fill in.
Tax to set aside every month
One row for each month with the money you moved to your tax account; tax collected, tax paid on costs, income tax on profit, the amount to set aside and the gap fill in.
Rate review for every kind of work
One row for each kind of work with your rate, the market rate and your cost; hours worked, value, margin, the suggested new rate and what the raise would add fill in.
Hiring plan and what each hire must earn
One row for each possible hire with hours, pay and set-up cost; the monthly cost with employer costs, the value of the hours, the monthly gain and the months to pay back fill in.
Utilisation by team member and month
One row for each team member and month with the client hours available; hours logged, billable hours, utilisation, value and the result against your target fill in.
Price increase plan for every client
One row for each client with the percentage you plan and the date; the new fee, the extra each month and each year and the brand fill in.

Hi, invoice {inv_id} for {brand} is ready: {total} including tax, due on {due}. Thank you for working with us.
Hi, a friendly reminder that invoice {inv_id} for {brand} ({balance}) is due on {due}.
Hi, invoice {inv_id} for {brand} was due on {due} and {balance} is still open ({days_over} days). Could you pay it this week?
Hi, invoice {inv_id} is {days_over} days overdue. As agreed, a late fee of {late_fee} now applies to the balance of {balance}. Can we settle it today?
Thank you for your payment on invoice {inv_id}. We received {paid} and {balance} is still open. Please send the rest by {due}.
Thank you, invoice {inv_id} for {brand} is paid in full.
Thank you, we received {amount} on {date} for invoice {invoice}.
Thank you for the payment of {amount}. It came {days_to_pay} days after the invoice. Could we move your payment date earlier next time?
Hi, your account with us: billed {billed}, paid {paid}, open {open}. Please tell us if anything looks different from your records.
Hi, {b3} for {brand} is more than 60 days overdue. We need to agree a payment date today so that the work can continue.
Hi, we understand cash can be tight. We can split the open {open} into two or three payments. Which dates suit you?
Hi, your next retainer invoice of {fee} plus tax goes out on {next_inv}. Please tell us if the billing details changed.
Hi, we paused your retainer of {fee}. When you are ready to restart, tell us and we will plan the first posts within a week.
Hi, thank you: we have worked together for {months} months. We will send a short review of results and ideas for the next quarter.
Hi, your request "{task}" is outside the package. It needs about {hours} hours and costs {charge}. Shall we go ahead?
Hi, we added "{task}" ({charge}) to your next invoice as agreed. Thank you.
Hi, we did "{task}" this time without charge (worth {charge}). Please tell us before similar requests so we can plan them.
Hi, from {effective} your monthly fee for {brand} changes from {fee} to {new_fee}. We are happy to talk it through.
Hi, a reminder that the new fee of {new_fee} starts on {effective}. Do you have any questions?
Thank you for accepting the new fee of {new_fee} from {effective}. We will keep delivering great results.
Hi, over the last 12 months we logged {hours} hours for {brand} on a fee of {fee} a month. Let us review the scope together so the plan stays fair for both of us.
Hi {name}, your billable utilisation over the last 90 days is {util} ({bill90} of {avail90} hours). Can we talk about your workload this week?
Hi {name}, you logged {hours90} hours in the last 90 days, with room for more. Can you take on a few extra posts?
Hi {member}, your {kind} from {start} to {end} ({wdays} working days) is approved. Please hand over open tasks before you go.
Hi {cover}, can you cover for {member} from {start} to {end} ({wdays} working days, {hours_lost} hours)?
Hi, the task "{title}" for {brand} is due on {due} with {left} hours left. Do you need help?
Hi, the task "{title}" for {brand} was due on {due} and is not done. Can you tell me the new date?
Thank you, "{title}" for {brand} is done after {hours_done} hours.
Service: {col:inv.kind}. Net amount {col:inv.net}, tax {col:inv.tax}, total {col:inv.total}. All amounts are in {set:currency}.
Please pay by {col:inv.due} ({set:terms} days terms). A late fee of {set:late_pct} of the open balance applies after {set:grace} days.
Invoice {col:inv.inv_id} for {col:inv.brand} of {col:inv.total} was due on {col:inv.due}. {col:inv.paid} has been paid and {col:inv.balance} is still open. Status: {col:inv.state}.
Please pay the open balance this week or tell us the date we can expect it.
If you already paid, please send us the transfer details so we can match it.

As agreed, a late fee of {col:inv.late_fee} is added after {set:grace} grace days.
Please pay the invoice and the fee together. We would rather agree a short plan with you than pause the work.
We received {col:pay.amount} from {col:pay.brand} for invoice {col:pay.invoice} by {col:pay.method}.
The payment came {col:pay.days_to_pay} days after the invoice was issued and was {col:pay.timing}.
Statement of account for {col:ar.brand}, prepared by {set:firm} on {today}.
Billed to date {col:ar.billed}, paid {col:ar.paid}, open balance {col:ar.open}. Not yet due: {col:ar.b0}. Overdue 1-30 days: {col:ar.b1}. 31-60 days: {col:ar.b2}. Over 60 days: {col:ar.b3}.
Your account status is {col:ar.state} and your agreed terms are {col:ar.terms} days.
Please contact us if anything on this statement looks different from your records.
Quote for extra work for {col:oos.brand}, issued by {set:firm} on {today}.
Request: {col:oos.task}. Estimated time {col:oos.hours} hours at {set:rate_hour} an hour, a price of {col:oos.charge}.
This work is outside your package. We start when you approve this quote in writing.
Please reply Approved to go ahead.
Notice of a fee change for {col:pi.brand}, from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
From {col:pi.effective} your monthly fee changes from {col:pi.fee} to {col:pi.new_fee}, an increase of {col:pi.pct}.
This keeps pace with our costs and the work we do for you. The extra is {col:pi.extra_month} a month.
Please contact us if you would like to talk about it before the date.
Retainer summary for {col:rt.brand}, prepared by {set:firm} on {today}.
Monthly fee {col:rt.fee} plus tax, invoiced on day {col:rt.bill_day} of each month. The retainer started on {col:rt.start} and its status is {col:rt.status}.
We have invoiced {col:rt.billed} in retainers so far. The next invoice goes out on {col:rt.next_inv}.
Work outside the package is quoted before we start.
Leave and cover note from {set:firm}, dated {today}.
{col:lv.member} is away on {col:lv.kind} from {col:lv.start} to {col:lv.end}: {col:lv.wdays} working days and {col:lv.hours_lost} hours.
Cover is by {col:lv.cover}. Please hand over open tasks and client contacts before the first day.
Role: {col:hp.role} ({col:hp.kind}), planned start {col:hp.start}, {col:hp.hours_month} hours a month. Cost a month with employer costs {col:hp.loaded}; set-up cost {col:hp.setup}.

The billable value of those hours is {col:hp.value} a month, a gain of {col:hp.net}. Break-even utilisation is {col:hp.be_util} and the set-up cost is repaid in {col:hp.payback} months. Verdict: {col:hp.state}.
Approval is needed before we advertise the role.

Open Start and type your agency name, your currency, the tax on invoices, your payment terms, your standard rate and cost per hour and your targets in the yellow cells.
Fill Team Members with each person, their cost per hour, charge-out rate and client hours a week. Hours, utilisation and workload fill in from the timesheet.
Log every block of work on Timesheet: date, person, brand, kind of work, hours and whether it is billable. The rate, cost of time and value fill in.
Raise each invoice on Invoices and each payment on Payments Received. Tax, balance, days overdue and the late fee fill in, and Receivables Ageing shows who to chase.
Keep Recurring Retainers and Price Increases up to date so you know the next invoice date, the income a year and the extra each increase brings.
Write every extra request on Out Of Scope Work so the price and the amount still to recover are never forgotten.
Enter expenses and tool subscriptions. Profit By Client and Profit By Package show where the money is made and lost, and Monthly Profit And Loss adds the overhead.
Check Cash Flow Forecast and Tax Set Aside every month, set the cash you have today in the settings and move the tax money on time.
Use Rate Review, Hiring Plan and Utilisation By Month before you raise prices, hire or promise more work.
Plan tasks and leave on Tasks And Workload and Leave And Cover so cover is agreed before people are away.

Use the 14 calculators for utilisation, hourly rate, client profit, price increases, hiring, cash runway, invoices, late fees, retainers, break-even, tool cost, bonus pool, extra work and leave cover.
Read Team And Finance Dashboard and Charts every week: overdue money, utilisation, profit, cash, tax and clients that lose money.
